The '''G-1A starfighter''' was a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] produced by [[Byblos Drive Yards/Legends|Byblos Drive Yards]]. It was 15 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long.<ref name="Gamer 7" />

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] and [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] used a modified G-1A, the [[Mist Hunter/Legends|''Mist Hunter'']].<ref name="OPF">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
